leadText:
Infernando (Japanese: ブラスケ Burasuke) is the self-proclaimed "fire-breathing clown and street performer extraordinaire" and a character of the day who appeared in A Ghost of a Chance.

He is a resident of Ecruteak City and a seller of the infamous treasure detector. His first attempt to sell it failed, as both and walked away from him, with Ash sensing the device was a scam. briefly expressed interest if only it would find him a girlfriend, his type of treasure.

Infernando later convinced James to buy the treasure seeker with the money Jessie and gave him to buy food. The treasure seeker was then used by James in both A Ghost of a Chance and From Ghost to Ghost.

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
Infernando is based on the of Generation II. His name is a combination of the word inferno and the name Fernando. The treasure detector he sells is a reference to the fact that the gets the Itemfinder (Dowsing MCHN in Generation IV) in Ecruteak City.
